question: The ____ took place in Assam in
solution:
The correct answer is __**Revolt of Songram Sangma**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Revolt of Songram Sangma** took place in **Assam**, and it is considered one of the significant tribal uprisings during British rule in India. 
• The **Garos**, a tribal community in the region, led this revolt against the oppressive policies of the British colonial administration, particularly focusing on their exploitation and unjust treatment. 
• This revolt was rooted in the **resistance to British revenue policies** and forest laws, which impacted the livelihoods and autonomy of the tribal people. 
• The revolt also symbolized the tribal aspiration for freedom and their fight to protect their cultural identity and traditional ways of life.
